quotations.old_english: Hwæðer se geþóht geeóde þe mid scylde þe mid lustfullnesse
quotations.latin: utrum cogitatio suggestione an delectatione acciderit

quotations.old_english: Eall þ-bar; manncynne tó ðám mǽstan góde geeóde

definitions.meaning: the verb here might be translated to traverse, the Latin

source_text: ge-gán; A. III 2. add :-- Hwæðer se geþóht geeóde þe mid scylde þe mid lustfullnesse utrum cogitatio suggestione an delectatione acciderit, Bd. 1, 27; Sch. 95, 17. B. II 4. add :-- Eall þ-bar; manncynne tó ðám mǽstan góde geeóde, Hml. A. 154, 58. IV. the verb here might be translated to traverse, the Latin
